description: A verification script for a plugin: PHP lint on every file, activation, the plugin's post types and REST routes registered, no new PHP errors from the plugin in debug.log, and Plugin Check when it is installed. Exits non-zero on failure. Set WP to the site's WP-CLI command, for example WP="wp --path=/path/to/site".
next: Run it on demand (when the user asks, or /provenlab:check), from the plugin folder on a local site: bash bin/verify.sh   (or WP="wp --path=/path/to/wordpress" bash bin/verify.sh), or in CI.
On WP Engine, do the quick checks only (a few wp commands through the WP Engine MCP server's sandbox_bash); run the full script there only if the user asks.
